text:
maya: Quick heads-up — opened a docs PR for the Optimize toolkit streaming + batching guidance, includes fallback strategy when a quantized model can't stream. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/423

ben: Nice. Can you call out the example migration flow from legacy SDK -> new SDK batching param? We need a tiny before/after snippet.

maya: Yes — added an SDK snippet in the examples section but it's terse. @docbot please run link-checker on the PR.

docbot: link-checker started for PR 423 — found 1 broken anchor in optimize/quantization-profiles.md#kv-prefetch (approx line 72).

sanjay: I can fix the anchor, it's from an old heading rename. Also we should add a compact sample showing prefetch config and a note about expected memory impact.

eli: Important: the streaming snippet uses continuous batching; if batch_size > 1 the fallback to scalar quantized model may need different KV cache handling. Left inline comments on the PR.

maya: Good catch. Here's the snippet I added (still needs env var sanitization):
```python
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))

resp = client.stream.generate(
  model="redwood/optimize-7b:quant-fallback",
  input="Summarize the meeting notes",
  batching={"enabled": True, "max_batch": 4},
  cache_prefetch={"enabled": True, "prefix_cache": "user_notes"}
)
for chunk in resp.streaming():
  print(chunk.text, end="")
```

lisa: Can we avoid putting api_key examples inline? Use env var like you changed, and add a one-line comment about KMS/HSM for private deployments. Also add a short sentence about latency tradeoffs when fallback happens.

ben: I'll push a tiny commit to sanitize the snippet (env var) and add a note about the KMS docs link. Leaving a TODO to add a small diagram in the migration guide.

maya: Thanks. Also added a 4-step migration checklist under docs/optimize/migration.md — could someone run the sample locally to ensure the snippet doesn't trigger the linter or the sample-output test?

sanjay: Happy to smoke-test. Will run locally with a small corpus and report back in this thread.

docbot: smoke test started for PR 423 — linter warnings detected: long line in snippet (line ~5) and trailing whitespace in migration.md (2 warnings).

maya: Fixed both in latest push and reduced line length for the snippet. Pushed commit.

lisa: One more ask — add a redirect from the old anchor (/optimize/quantization-profiles.md#kv-prefetch) to the new heading and a short changelog entry. I'll send a commit for the redirect and changelog.

eli: After we merge, let's add a small note in the release notes and tag it optimize-docs v0.9.1. Also capture the fallback performance numbers in the PR description so customers can set expectations.

maya: Agreed. Targeting merge tomorrow EOD unless any other blockers. :thumbsup:
